notes: This file is an evidence template. PREPARED/OPEN/BLOCKED values are not release passes. No gate may become PASS until it is bound to one immutable release candidate commit. Mutable PR head/behind values are intentionally not stored as durable truth; GitHub compare is the live source immediately before review/merge.
